summary: Bisignano disclosed 118 transactions between May 16, 2025, and June 16, 2026, consisting of 80 purchases (estimated $535.9 million) and 38 sales (estimated $434.4 million), for a cumulative estimated total of $970.4 million across all tracked filings. The largest single transaction was a trade in Franklin NJ Tax Free Income A (FNJQX), with an estimated value between $25,000,001 and $50,000,000. The most-traded asset was Fiserv, appearing in 20 transactions, followed by several Vanguard exchange-traded funds. One of the 118 transactions, or 1 percent, was filed late.
